description: This source file provides utility methods for tracing HTTP requests and AMQP commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes functions to prepare timers with relevant tags for measuring request roundtrip durations and authentication process metrics.

classes.name: TraceUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating tracing timers associated with HTTP requests, AMQP commands, and authentication filtering in distributed tracing.

methods.name: newHttpRoundTripTimer
methods.description: Prepares an ExpiringTimerBuilder configured for measuring HTTP roundtrip times, extracting method and path tags from an HttpRequest.

methods.name: newAmqpRoundTripTimer
methods.description: Prepares an ExpiringTimerBuilder for measuring AMQP message roundtrip times from a Command or Signal object.

methods.name: newAuthFilterTimer
methods.description: Prepares an ExpiringTimerBuilder for authentication filtering metrics, with optional extraction of request tags from an HttpRequest.

methods.name: metricizeTraceUri
methods.description: Sanitizes trace URI strings to be compatible with metric naming conventions by replacing invalid characters with delimiters.
